arguments.Title: 40km/h 도서관 전체 경로 측정 시작
arguments.Code: using UnityEngine; using InhaExpress.Client.Presentation; internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand { public void Execute(ExecutionResult result) { var c=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<UnityAutonomousClient>(); var v=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<VehicleController>(); var hud=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<WebClientHud>(); hud.OperatorControls.SelectVehicle("V01"); Camera cam=null; foreach(var candidate in Object.FindObjectsByType<Camera>(FindObjectsSortMode.None)) if(candidate.enabled&&candidate.targetTexture==null) cam=candidate; var recorder=v.gameObject.AddComponent<CampusDriveTelemetry>(); recorder.Begin(v,c,cam,"artifacts/high_speed_drive/library-40.csv",300); c.SimulationCruiseKmh=40; c.StartMission("library_road_candidate"); result.Log("start speed=40 vehicle="+v.OperatorVehicleId+" pos="+v.transform.position+" camera="+cam.name); } }
